card.name: Comma after elderly in ACE/ARB warnings
card.fires_on: The comma right after "elderly" in NSAID and ACE inhibitor/ARB interaction text, just before "volume-depleted". It also fires on "with" after "patients" in similar drug-interaction warnings.

modes.label: Comma after elderly
modes.description: Comma in a list of at-risk groups, after "elderly", before "volume-depleted" and renal impairment.
modes.example: Concomitant use with piroxicam capsules in elderly<<,>> volume depleted, or those with renal impairment

modes.label: "with" after patients
modes.description: The word "with" after "in patients", introducing a condition such as diabetes or hereditary angioedema.
modes.example: Do not coadminister aliskiren with valsartan in patients<< with>> diabetes.

card.plain: It marks the point in an interaction warning where a list of at-risk groups (elderly, volume-depleted, kidney impairment) continues.
